methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 8,192 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try at the base odds per Pokémon.

methods.name: Masuda Method
methods.plain: Breed two Pokémon whose games are in different languages: the eggs have a much better shiny chance.
methods.detail: If the egg isn't shiny, the game re-rolls its personality value up to 4 more times: 5 tries in all, about 1 in 1,639. Sites that say 1 in 2,048 count only the re-rolls.
methods.note: pokeplatinum src/overlay005/daycare.c and pokeheartgold src/get_egg.c: 1 PID + up to 4 re-rolls = 5 checks. The re-rolls come from a seeded chain, so 5/8192 is the standard approximation; Serebii's 1/2,048 counts only the re-rolls.
